theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      omega
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ?_
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply fn_ih
        exact H1
        intros x Hin
        exact List.mem_append_left (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e) Hin
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply e_ih
        assumption
        intros x Hin
        exact List.mem_append_right (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars fn) Hin
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply ih <;> assumption
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    rename_i e_normalized
    rename_i tr_normalized
    rename_i tr e ty k
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      grind
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

"""Standalone workspace client for the host's proof and source tools."""

import argparse
import json
import socket
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="op", required=True)
    for op in ("check", "goals"):
        commands.add_parser(op).add_argument("file")
    profile = commands.add_parser(
        "profile", help="Diagnostic tactic heartbeat hotspots"
    )
    profile.add_argument("file")
    profile.add_argument("--version")
    profile.add_argument("--threshold-raw", type=int, default=10_000)
    profile.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=20)
    commands.add_parser("status")
    commands.add_parser("finish").add_argument("--reason", required=True)
    search = commands.add_parser("search")
    search.add_argument("query")
    search.add_argument("--version")
    search.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=30)
    for op in ("read", "outline"):
        sub = commands.add_parser(op)
        sub.add_argument(
            "path", help="Lean source path, relative to the pinned project"
        )
        sub.add_argument("--version")
        if op == "read":
            sub.add_argument("--start", type=int, default=1)
            sub.add_argument("--end", type=int, default=180)
    args = vars(parser.parse_args())
    workspace = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if args["op"] in ("check", "goals", "profile"):
        path = Path(args.pop("file"))
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = workspace / path
        args["code"] = path.read_text()
    endpoint = json.loads((workspace / "tool_service.json").read_text())
